free_tier.stated: 300 email sends per day with no time limit; 100,000 contacts stored
free_tier.notes: Every email sent from the Free plan carries the Sent with Brevo sticker; up to 2,000 unique contacts can enter active automations; one user. Once the 300 daily sends are used, no campaign can be scheduled for the next day. The Free plan's limits page names no restriction on recipients.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a send count rather than an object

retention.stated: unused sends do not roll over

tooling: any SMTP client, or the Brevo API
chaining: the highest card-free daily cap found: 300/day, which is three times Resend's. It is the outbound half of the inbound-plus-outbound chain and its scarce link is the day.

limits.value: 300 sends per day, resetting daily, with no carry-over
a campaign to more than 300 recipients delivers to 300 that day and needs a manual requeue, so the daily send counter is the campaign's limit too

transactional sending over SMTP or the API needs a separate activation by the vendor, requested by a support ticket from the account, before the first send; the time it takes is unverified: behind a sign-up

identity_cost.detail: Signup asks for an email and a password, or a Google or Apple sign-in, with no card; the account then verifies the email and asks for basic business information. Whether a mobile phone number with an SMS code is also required is unverified: behind a sign-up; users on the vendor's community forum report a phone number and SMS code step during registration. A sender on a free domain such as gmail.com cannot be authenticated, and the vendor states that mail from a free address is rejected or filtered to spam, so delivery needs a domain the sender controls.

reliability_note: once the daily limit is hit, up to 1,000 transactional emails are held in a retry queue and anything beyond that is not delivered

evidence.proved: 'The Free plan includes 300 email sends per day', unused sends do not roll over, and a campaign above 300 recipients needs the Requeue option on successive days
'Send 300 emails a day with the best free SMTP server'
banner 250, EHLO advertises SIZE and 8BITMIME, STARTTLS completed against the system trust store, and AUTH LOGIN returned 334. The submission endpoint answers; no message was sent

notes: The help page states the campaign behaviour explicitly, which is why the 300/day figure is not the whole answer for a marketing send.
binding_note: 300/day. The campaign path is the trap: a 1,000-contact list takes four days.
interface_detail: the SMTP relay and the transactional API; SMTP is the documented path
confidence_note: no message was sent, so no delivery is proved. The submission path was probed: smtp-relay.brevo.com:587 answered 250, STARTTLS completed against the system trust store, and AUTH LOGIN returned 334
limits_note: counts of things, not rates, so no vocabulary kind names them: 100,000 contacts stored on the free plan. The campaign entry is a rate: the same 300-a-day counter is what a campaign meets, so it stays request-rate
